title: Auto-enter calc overwrites existing value
description: Error-prone rule — fields whose auto-enter calculation replaces an existing value. This can silently clobber user edits on every change.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: "Do not replace existing value" unchecked means the calc wins over manual edits.
rule.remediation: Confirm the overwrite is intended; otherwise re-enable "Do not replace existing value".
